content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Des Moines

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential thresholds for your background. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify whether your experience qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples and interactive labs designed to anchor PMP knowledge for Des Moines professionals across insurance, healthcare, agribusiness, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI. Document your project-management experience, education, and training hours. Pay PMI's exam fee and await approval—typically processed within two weeks. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, including practice tests and strategy sessions, to build confidence. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center or via proctored remote delivery. Plan for a comprehensive assessment of project-management domains and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification requires renewal every three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through PMI-approved training, volunteering, and on-the-job project work. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing continuing-education courses to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in your field.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
